widget.name: Manager assistant
widget.short_description: Customer reply and an upsell suggestion
widget.description:
Open the assistant in a lead card and paste the customer request and relevant conversation. The service prepares a customer reply and a separate suggestion for the manager.

The assistant can also open in a new tab. Copy the conversation manually and review the reply before sending it.
widget.tour_description: Open the assistant → paste the conversation → review both result blocks.

settings.service_url: Assistant HTTPS URL (no keys or query parameters)

ui.intro: Prepare a polite customer reply and a relevant additional offer.
ui.steps: Copy the customer request and relevant conversation messages. Paste them into the assistant, then review the result.
ui.frame_title: Manager assistant: customer reply and upsell
ui.new_tab: If the embedded view does not load, open the assistant in a new tab. The manager sends the reply.
ui.invalid_url: Set a valid assistant HTTPS URL in the integration settings. Do not include credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
ui.settings_help: Example: https://assistant.example.com/. Use the interface URL, not /suggest or Ollama. Enter the access key in the assistant itself.
